d: Bageshvar dham ke kathavachak dhirendr krishn shastri dvara madhy pradesh ke karaira men katha ke dauran bhagvan shrikrishn ke svarup aur unki mudra ko lekar di gaee vivadit tippani par deshbhar men ghamasan mach gaya hai. is bayan ke samne aane ke bad bihar ke purniya se nirdaliy sansad rajesh ranjan urph pappu yadav ne kara rukh apnaya hai. pappu yadav dilli ke parliyament strit pulis steshan pahunche aur dhirendr krishn shastri ke khilaph dharmik bhavnaon ko thes pahunchane tatha samajik sauhard bigarne ke aarop men likhit shikayat dekar FIR darj karaee. sansad pappu yadav ne kare…
